title: Gemini UFO audio and airbrushed UFO in NASA textbook

tellings.quote: And then in the they have this um book actually, the Simpkinson uh textbook that shout out to my buddy Chris Ramsay from the great show Area 52.

related.note: Both are about the UFO image in the Simpkinson Gemini material. This telling says a real UFO was airbrushed into or shown in the textbook, while Knuth's story says the original photo has no UFO and the image is a mock-up.

plain: During NASA's Gemini flights of the 1960s, the two-man missions in Earth orbit, astronauts are said to have been recorded talking about a UFO, and a picture of an object is said to have been airbrushed into a NASA textbook known as the Simpkinson textbook. Michels mentions this briefly and credits his friend Chris Ramsay, host of the show Area 52, for finding the book. If true, it would mean NASA's own material had once shown something unexplained in orbit.
